title: Enrolment
question: Is your business enrolled and its AUSTRAC information current?

title: Risk assessment
question: Have you documented and reviewed the risks your business faces?

title: Written program
question: Do staff follow documented policies and procedures?

title: Approval and oversight
question: Is the program approved by a senior manager and overseen by your governing body?

title: Compliance officer
question: Is an appropriate management-level officer appointed and carrying out the role?

title: Initial CDD
question: Do you establish customer identity, ownership, purpose and risk before service, subject to permitted exceptions?

title: Ongoing CDD
question: Do you review changes, update information and address unusual activity?

title: Existing customer reviews
question: Have you recorded your existing customers’ risk ratings, where required, and set risk-based periodic CDD review dates?
note: Use your program’s categories, such as low, medium or high. Apply the special rules for pre-commencement customers and review sooner when circumstances change.

title: Reporting
question: Can your team identify, assess and submit required reports within applicable deadlines?

title: Records and people
question: Are records retained and relevant personnel checked and trained?

title: Independent evaluation
question: Have you arranged evaluation within the applicable timetable?
